QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] The Blocked Canal
QuestInfo.0: A #bRobed Lady#k saved you and Leon from the Delfinos. You wondered why she did that...
QuestInfo.1: The Robed Lady demanded a reward for saving you. As soon as Leon handed her the reward, she disappeared. You wanted to return to San Commerci, but Leon wanted to look around some more.
QuestInfo.2: The Robed Lady demanded a reward for saving you. As soon as Leon handed her the reward, she disappeared. You wanted to return to San Commerci, but Leon wanted to look around some more. Just as you started to accuse him of being smitten, you found a strange barrier, which you decide to report to Gilberto.
